summary: Undeclared dependencies and missing environment variable safety checks in token generation.

findings.title: Undeclared Dependency 'jsonwebtoken'
findings.body: The module 'jsonwebtoken' is imported in src/token.js but not declared as a dependency in package.json. This will cause a runtime crash with 'Error: Cannot find module 'jsonwebtoken'' when the application attempts to load src/token.js.
findings.recommendation: Add "jsonwebtoken": "^9.0.2" to the dependencies object in package.json.

findings.title: Missing check for process.env.JWT_SECRET
findings.body: The 'issue' function in src/token.js invokes jwt.sign with process.env.JWT_SECRET without checking if the environment variable is set. If JWT_SECRET is undefined, jwt.sign will throw a synchronous 'secretOrPrivateKey must have a value' error, which could crash the application or cause unhandled exceptions.
findings.recommendation: Add an assertion at startup or inside the 'issue' function to ensure process.env.JWT_SECRET is defined before attempting to sign tokens.

samples.summary: Undeclared 'jsonwebtoken' dependency and missing validation for the mandatory JWT_SECRET environment variable will cause runtime failures in production.

findings.title: Undeclared dependency on 'jsonwebtoken' in package.json
findings.body: The newly added file 'src/token.js' imports 'jsonwebtoken', but the package.json dependency manifest does not list 'jsonwebtoken' as a dependency. This will cause a MODULE_NOT_FOUND error and runtime failure in production or after any clean npm installation.
findings.recommendation: Add 'jsonwebtoken' to the dependencies object in package.json.

findings.title: Missing validation for mandatory JWT_SECRET environment variable
findings.body: In 'src/token.js', jwt.sign is called using 'process.env.JWT_SECRET' without any prior validation. If the environment variable JWT_SECRET is not configured, jwt.sign will throw a synchronous error ('secretOrPrivateKey must have a value') which is unhandled and can crash the application process.
findings.recommendation: Assert that process.env.JWT_SECRET is defined and non-empty during application initialization or before calling jwt.sign, raising a descriptive configuration error if missing.

findings.title: Stray runtime state file tracked by Git
findings.body: The file '.omc/state/job.json' stores ephemeral execution state (including pid and running status). Committing or tracking local runner state in git is an anti-pattern as it causes merge conflicts and pollutes the repository with environment-specific information.
findings.recommendation: Remove '.omc/state/job.json' from git tracking and add '.omc/' to the repository's .gitignore file.

samples.summary: Identified a missing dependency (jsonwebtoken), an unvalidated environment variable for JWT signing, and an ephemeral runtime state file staged for commit.

findings.title: Missing jsonwebtoken dependency in package.json
findings.body: The new file src/token.js imports 'jsonwebtoken', which is not listed as a dependency in package.json. This will cause a runtime crash ('Cannot find module') in environments where dependencies are freshly installed.
findings.recommendation: Install and add 'jsonwebtoken' to package.json, for example by running 'npm install jsonwebtoken'.

findings.title: Unvalidated JWT secret environment variable
findings.body: The issue() function in src/token.js uses process.env.JWT_SECRET without checking if it is defined. If the environment variable is missing, jwt.sign() will synchronously throw a 'secretOrPrivateKey must have a value' error.
findings.recommendation: Assert that process.env.JWT_SECRET is defined at application startup, or throw a clear configuration error if it is missing.

findings.title: Ephemeral runtime state file tracked in git
findings.body: The file .omc/state/job.json contains active runtime process info (status 'running', pid 4242) and is being tracked. Committing state or process files pollutes the repository and leaks local system details.
findings.recommendation: Create a .gitignore file containing '.omc/', and remove the file from git tracking using 'git rm --cached .omc/state/job.json'.
